Container.Name: fuellog
Container.Overview: Self-hosted fuel-consumption tracker for your household's vehicles. Log fill-ups, see average consumption, range, cost per km and a monthly spending chart. Automatically estimates missing values (odometer readings, litres, amounts) and marks them as estimates. English and German UI, configurable currency, optional OpenStreetMap station lookup. All data lives in a single SQLite file under /data.
Container.Description: Self-hosted fuel-consumption tracker. Create your admin account on first launch; add vehicles and log fill-ups. Back up by copying the /data folder.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded photos and the generated secret key

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone (affects the default date on the entry form)

Config.Name: Default language
Config.Description: Fallback UI language before you set one in Settings (en or de)

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to let the app generate and persist one under /data
